json_decode: 1) Decode CGI body with Content-Type charset (observed windows-1252). 2) Locate <!-- ALGOGEBRA_JSON_BEGIN ... ALGOGEBRA_JSON_END -->. 3) json.loads the inner text (ASCII keys/numbers; strings may use \u escapes).
grade_client_rule: Preserve observed integer values 0 and 1. Client must accept JSON numbers (int or float) — do not require decimal literals (0.0) and do not require string "0"/"1".

given.rule: WIMS normalizes via !singlespace (and escape passes) before emit. Do not present answers[].given as the exact text the student typed.

invalid_answer_vs_missing_hook.client_distinction_without_new_status: Do NOT add a JSON status field without approval. 1) If ALGOGEBRA_JSON_BEGIN present → hook fired (use grade/answers). 2) If absent and answer_analysis present → reply graded but hook missing/off (special_parm absent or not installed). 3) If absent and sure/incomplete UI (e.g. h1 Êtes-vous sûr / exo_formCheck) → WIMS did not finish grading this POST; treat as retry/incomplete page, not as a missing-hook grade result.
